title: Coulthart: Republican presidents briefed, Democrats not

tellings.quote: Ross Coulthart recently came out and talked about how there sometimes seems to be a contrast between Republican presidents getting information and Democrat presidents not.

plain: Jason Simosa, a researcher appearing on Jesse Michels's podcast, passes on a recent remark by Ross Coulthart, a journalist who reports on UFOs. According to Simosa, Coulthart said there sometimes seems to be a pattern in which Republican US presidents are told about secret UFO matters while Democratic presidents are not. If true, it would mean that even presidents only get this information when the people holding it choose.
